usage: The word '收納箱' is a noun referring to a box used for keeping and organizing items.
It can be used to talk about different types of storage boxes found in the bedroom or other rooms.
You can use it as a subject or object in a sentence, such as "我有一個收納箱" (I have a storage box).
It can also be combined with quantifiers like 個 (go3) when counting, for example, "兩個收納箱" (two storage boxes).
